races.type: Federal Partisan Office • Vote for One
races.title: United States Representative, New Hampshire Congressional District 1
races.overview: Represents the voters of Manchester, NH in the U.S. House of Representatives. Manages federal lawmaking, national budget appropriations, constituent advocacy, and federal agency oversight.

candidates.name: Chris Pappas
candidates.desc: Democratic candidate focusing on healthcare access, education funding, public infrastructure, and environmental policy for Manchester, NH.

candidates.name: Russell Prescott
candidates.desc: Republican candidate advocating for fiscal discipline, tax reduction, economic growth, public safety, and streamlined regulation in New Hampshire.

races.type: State Partisan Office • Vote for One
races.title: New Hampshire State Senate
races.overview: Represents local constituents in the New Hampshire State Senate. Authors state statutes, sets state tax policy, and votes on public education budgets.

candidates.name: State Senator (Manchester, NH)
candidates.desc: Incumbent legislator prioritizing community economic development, infrastructure improvements, and healthcare access in Manchester, NH.

races.type: State Partisan Office • Vote for One
races.title: New Hampshire House of Representatives
races.overview: Serves in the New Hampshire House of Representatives crafting state policies and constituent services for Manchester, NH.

candidates.name: State Representative (Manchester, NH)
candidates.desc: Focuses on local job creation, public safety, public school funding, and constituent advocacy.

races.title: Manchester, NH County Executive / Prosecutor
races.overview: Oversees countywide criminal justice, public health, law enforcement, and regional services for Manchester, NH.

candidates.name: County Candidate A
candidates.desc: Focuses on court efficiency, victim advocacy, public safety, and community diversion programs.

candidates.name: County Candidate B
candidates.desc: Focuses on administrative reforms, fiscal oversight, and law enforcement support.
